description: This is a main activity class for an Android application handling permission requests and UI interactions, including menu management, fragment transactions, and logging setup.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing UI elements, fragment transactions, menu options, and logging initialization for the permission request sample app.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and loads the PermissionRequestFragment if no saved state exists.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for the activity.

methods.name: onPrepareOptionsMenu
methods.description: Prepares the options menu, adjusting the visibility and text of the log toggle menu item based on the current state.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles selection events for menu items, toggling log display.

methods.name: initializeLogging
methods.description: Sets up the logging mechanism, connecting custom log wrapper and filter, and prepares the log fragment.
